claimsMade.text: THE NAMED LOCAL NEGATIVE. Norio Hayakawa, who has worked the Dulce question since 1988 and is a proponent of investigating the subject rather than a professional debunker, states on his own site: 'it does not seem to exist'.

Schneider was not part of the initial Dulce rumours and emerged only in 1995, according to Norio Hayakawa's dated chronology of the cluster's originators, which places the initial rumours between about 1979 and the early 1980s.

Bennewitz is the origin point of the Dulce claim, from about 1979, in the dated chronology of the cluster's originators. Myrna Hansen's 1980 abduction claim was connected to Dulce by Bennewitz after he had begun to suspect a facility there.

Lear heard of Dulce from a woman named as 'Ann West' and developed his Dulce hypothesis in 1988, in the dated chronology of the cluster's originators. The same name appears in Tal Levesque's November 2015 confession as the raw material from which he composed the two original Dulce Base articles.

Levesque wrote under the name Jason Bishop III, and had maintained across a multi-year correspondence with Gorightly that Castello was a real person and the Dulce material authentic, before the November 2015 message.

label: Norio Hayakawa
narrative: Norio Hayakawa, writing as the Civilian Intelligence News Service, has worked the Dulce question since 1988 and concluded against it, which makes him the most useful negative in the cluster. He is not a professional debunker of the subject; he is a proponent of investigating it, which is exactly why his negative carries more than a debunker's would. His own words on his own site, 29 August 2016, on the alleged facility: 'it does not seem to exist'. The same post supplies the dated chronology of the cluster's originators that this board uses: Bennewitz from about 1979; Myrna Hansen in 1980, whom Bennewitz later decided had been taken to Dulce; Tom Adams in the early 1980s by way of cattle-mutilation work around 1981; John Lear in 1988, who came to it through 'Ann West'; and Phil Schneider only in 1995. He is also the publisher of record, for this board, of Tal Levesque's confession, which he reproduced on 23 April 2021 and again on 2 April 2024 with the verbatim text. His posts are self-published and are graded accordingly at Tier 2, as a named person on the record about his own findings.
